notes.title: Boring Movies is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Today is the day! Boring Movies is now live on Steam and can be played by anyone in the world. 

Along with the excitement there has been a major change to lobbies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969488/f136ff519476cca139f4d1065098a60f396d8f69.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Lobby hosts can now set how many rounds will be played. 
[*] Can now pick from Movie or Series (requires host owns the Boring Television DLC)
[*] Filter Modes have been added; both Decade or Genres
[/list]

I'm super excited for this change and would like to thank AROAH for the filter suggestion from the Steam Next Fest demo. 

As well there was a number of minor bug fixes and some UI adjustments; the biggest being that you can now use Enter to submit movie search and guesses. 

Thanks everyone for playing in the playtest, demo, and going forward! 

NOTE: None of the DLC (Avatars & Boring Television) are currently available. They are currently going through Steam review and will be available shortly along with a Supporter Bundle to get them all at a discount.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is Live!
notes.notes:
Today is the start of the big day! Steam Next Fest begins today and runs until October 21st. This means a brand new and improved version of Boring Movies is playable right now. 

I'm also happy to announce that Boring Movies will officially launch on [u][b]November 5th, 2024[/b][/u]. As well I would like to just lightly cover some of the things I have planned for the 1.0 launch. 

[list]
[*] A more film thematic UI
[*] Customizable lobby options
[*] Some [i]magic[/i] themed avatars
[*] Downloadable OST
[/list]

Lobby Options Planned
[list]
[*] A limited guesses mode
[*] Set the number of rounds
[*] TV Mode / Game Mode
[*] Genre Specific Rules
[*] Configure the guess-title matching
[/list]

Have questions or feedback? Join the Discord!
https://discord.gg/RBPesMj


Change Log
[list]
[*] Better UI Scaling to Support Widescreen
[*] Improved layout of the Winner screen
[*] Round Runner can visually see what people guess
[*] Better score feedback effect
[*] Example boring descriptions added during wait screens
[*] Added a discord button
[*] Added more of the avatars to the list that will be available on launch
[*] Fixed bugs with matching guesses to the film title
[*] Fixed resetting scores when replaying 
[*] Fixed hiding the room code when hovering the copy button
[*] A number of minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Public Playtest
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first public playtest weekend of Boring Movies!

We are gearing up for our upcoming release on Nov 5th, and we're thrilled to have you join us for this special event. During each playtest weekend, running from Friday 9 A.M. EST to Monday 9 A.M. EST, we will be focusing on improving different parts of the game and locating any bugs or edge cases that could affect gameplay. Your feedback is crucial in helping us identify and fix these issues, so please don't hesitate to report any bugs you encounter. Simply press the ESC key at any time to access an in-game bug submission form.

We greatly appreciate your participation to enhance the game before its final release. If you would like to engage directly with the developer and share your feedback, join the Fishagon community on [url=https://discord.gg/RBPesMj]Discord[/url] or catch the development process live on [url=https://twitch.tv/skytech6]Twitch[/url].

And if you enjoy playing Boring Movies, consider adding it to your Wishlists to receive notifications upon launch.

Thank you for being a part of this exciting journey with us!
